Marco: quick pulse — v2 migration status. can owners call out any blocking issues by EOD? canary metrics snapshot is due TOMORROW 09:00 PT. cc @Anita @Lee @Sam @Priya :thumbsup:
Anita: sdk update — PR #4821 is ready for review, failing only on linux wheel CI (pip build flake). adding logs in PR. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4821
Lee: compat tests are tripping on the header rename (X-Model-Version -> X-Model). repro locally: ```curl -v -H 'X-Model: v2' http://localhost:8080/generate``` returns 400 with "unknown header". digging into adapter layer now.
Sam: infra note — token-propagation fix merged to staging earlier today, deploy scheduled tonight 22:00 PT. heads up: auth header normalization will change (old: Authorization: Bearer <token>, new: Authorization: Token <token>) so runtime adapters may need a tiny tweak.
Priya: Dedicated/private teams need a config flag flip for routing policy. I can add a canary toggle in Console by EOD and include rollback steps. who owns private rollout?
Lee: I can open a small compat patch to accept both header names and add a unit test. will post PR shortly.
Anita: also: SDK bump for client-side header rename is blocked until CI passes — pinging @devx for a flaky wheel fix. if CI green, we'll cut a canary package tonight.
DeployBot: CI Report — sdk-tests: failed (2 flaky), runtime-e2e: passing, compat-suite: failing (header tests). See: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/2468
Marco: summary/actions — 1) Anita: chase CI flake + cut canary if green; 2) Lee: open compat PR and add acceptance test; 3) Sam: post exact deploy window and rollback plan for infra change; 4) Priya: add canary toggle + docs for Dedicated/Private; 5) Marco: coordinate cross-team smoke once deploy done. target next async check-in 1hr (approx). please add short comments when items are done.
Anita: acked, i'll post CI follow-up here when fixed. :eyes:
Lee: PR up -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4830 — small adapter change + test. tagging @Marco for quick review.
Sam: deploy plan posted: https://docs.redwood.internal/deploys/token-prop-2025 (22:00 PT -> 22:30 PT, rollback steps included). will notify oncall 15m before.
Priya: canary toggle is created and scoped to 10% traffic for first 2h. docs updated.
Marco: perfect — thanks everyone. i'll re-open thread if anything else blocks; otherwise we'll reconvene after the deploy smoke results.
